1) Confirm that mid-October is still the commit window for budget (yes/no).
2) Share the primary procurement contact & any contract redlines.
3) If helpful, we can put together a 4-week pilot plan and a compact SOW for procurement.

Attachments: FinGrid_Redwood_demo-deck.pdf (pptx) — product fit and throughput numbers; redwood-sow-stub.docx (docx) — starter SOW you can share with procurement.

Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up next week to review pilot scope and PO timing. If mid-Oct is tight for you, tell me and I’ll propose an escalation path.

Thanks — Camila
